verdicts.tldr: staging's img-src gateway lives in a host file while the gateway it must match comes from the watchtower-updated image default
verdicts.details: misc/loop/traefik/gno.yml:7 hardcodes https://ipfs.filebase.io in img-src, and the gnoweb router applies it via secure-headers@file (docker-compose.yml:71). The gnoweb service runs ghcr.io/gnolang/gno/gnoweb:master with no --ipfs-gateway flag, so its gateway is DefaultIPFSGateway from whatever image is pulled. A later change to the default reaches staging without the traefik file following, and IPFS images there get blocked. Latent only: both agree at merge. Fix: add --ipfs-gateway=https://ipfs.filebase.io to the gnoweb command in misc/loop/docker-compose.yml, or drop the IPFS host from the traefik img-src.
verdicts.evidence: grep -n -i ipfs misc/loop/docker-compose.yml: no hit; docker-compose.yml gnoweb command lists --bind, --remote, --chainid, --with-analytics, --faucet-url only; docker-compose.yml:71 middlewares=secure-headers@file; handler.go:149 os.WriteFile(plh.cfg.TraefikGnoFile, ...)
verdicts.verify_by: grep -c ipfs misc/loop/docker-compose.yml (0: no flag pins the gateway); sed -n 149p misc/loop/cmd/portalloop/handler.go (in-place write of gno.yml); once staging answers again (503 on 2026-10-16), curl -sD - -o /dev/null https://staging.gno.land/ | grep -i content-security-policy to see which CSP the browser gets

verdicts.tldr: web25 still emits https://ipfs.io/ipfs/<CID> links, readable correctly only through gnoweb's rewrite
verdicts.details: GetLink returns "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/" + c.CID, and Render substitutes it into a markdown link. gnoweb rewrites ipfs.io (it is in ipfsRetiredGateways), but any reader without that rewrite (gnoweb with an empty gateway, a qeval of GetLink) gets a link on the gateway the PR treats as retired. It is the one example that writes the markdown itself, so it can follow the PR's own advice to prefer ipfs://. Fix: return "ipfs://" + c.CID.
verdicts.evidence: web25.gno:29 return "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/" + c.CID; git grep 'ipfs.io/ipfs' -- examples also hits r/sacha/coinflip/render.gno:70 and r/sacha/home/home.gno:21 (md.Image) and the r/docs/markdown text; ext_ipfs.go:19 "ipfs.io": false in ipfsRetiredGateways. ipfs.io's 403 not measured here.
verdicts.verify_by: git grep -n 'ipfs.io/ipfs' -- examples ; then render web25.Config{CID: "bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi"}.Render("") through NewHTMLRenderer with IPFSGateway "" and with the default, and compare the href. Fix: return "ipfs://" + c.CID

verdicts.tldr: with a default Kubo at http://localhost:8080, images may redirect to <cid>.ipfs.localhost, which the CSP does not list
verdicts.details: The code side reads as claimed: normalizeIPFSGateway accepts http://localhost:8080 (ipfs_test.go:26) and SecureHeadersMiddleware adds only that bare origin to img-src. Whether Kubo answers a localhost path request with a subdomain redirect, and whether the browser blocks the redirect hop, needs a Kubo daemon and a browser, neither available here. Fix: if confirmed, document http://127.0.0.1:8080 as the local gateway or add *.ipfs.localhost to img-src for a localhost gateway.
verdicts.evidence: main.go:467-469 imgSrc gets only " " + ipfsGateway; ipfs_test.go:26 {"http://localhost:8080", "http://localhost:8080"}. Kubo redirect not run: no daemon here.
verdicts.verify_by: With a default-config Kubo daemon: curl -sI http://localhost:8080/ipfs/<cid> shows Location: http://<cid>.ipfs.localhost:8080/; run gnoweb -ipfs-gateway http://localhost:8080 on a page with ![x](ipfs://<cid>) in a headful browser: expect a CSP img-src violation on <cid>.ipfs.localhost

verdicts.tldr: the test comment says NewDefaultAppConfig shares DefaultAliases, but it already returns a clone
verdicts.details: ipfs_test.go:86 clones cfg.Aliases with the comment 'NewDefaultAppConfig shares DefaultAliases', while app.go:140 sets Aliases: maps.Clone(DefaultAliases). The clone is redundant and the comment misstates the constructor, inviting the same defensive clone elsewhere. Fix: delete the line, or keep it with a comment that does not claim sharing.
verdicts.evidence: ipfs_test.go:86 cfg.Aliases = maps.Clone(cfg.Aliases) // NewDefaultAppConfig shares DefaultAliases; app.go:140 Aliases: maps.Clone(DefaultAliases), // callers add their own
verdicts.verify_by: sed -n 140p gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go in head and base: `Aliases: maps.Clone(DefaultAliases), // callers add their own` | sed -n 140p gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go shows the clone; delete ipfs_test.go:86 and run go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run 'IPFS|Alias' -race -count=1: stays green

verdicts.tldr: IPv4 shorthands such as 127.1 pass validation, and the browser may then block every IPFS image
verdicts.details: The regex accepts 127.1 and 0x7f000001: every label matches [a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?, so normalizeIPFSGateway returns https://127.1 and it enters the CSP. The loss, a browser normalising the img URL to 127.0.0.1 and then failing to match the literal host-source, was not observed in a browser here. Fix: reject hosts made only of digits, dots and hex forms that are not dotted-quad (net.ParseIP on all-numeric hosts).
verdicts.evidence: ipfs.go:21 regexp `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*$`; ipfs.go:66 returns u.Scheme + "://" + strings.ToLower(u.Host) unchanged. Browser CSP check not run.
verdicts.verify_by: read the regex: every label of `127.1` and `0x7f000001` matches [a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?; then load a page whose CSP img-src is https://127.1 with in a headful browser and watch the violation

verdicts.tldr: newButtonLink hand-builds the same raw-label link that newLinkFromAutoLink now factors
verdicts.details: newLinkFromAutoLink (ext_links.go:172-179) does NewLink, set Destination, NewString(label), SetRaw(true), AppendChild; newButtonLink (ext_buttons.go:77-84) does exactly those steps plus one SetAttribute. The helper's autolink-specific name is what keeps the button from using it. Button body goes from 8 lines to 3 (call plus SetAttribute plus return). Fix: rename to newRawLabelLink and call it from newButtonLink, then SetAttribute on the result.

verdicts.tldr: a gateway rejected for carrying credentials is printed verbatim, credentials included, in the startup error
verdicts.details: NewRouter returns fmt.Errorf("invalid IPFS gateway %q: %w", cfg.RenderConfig.IPFSGateway, err), quoting the raw flag value even when the reason is 'must not contain credentials' or a query token; render.go:98 logs the same raw value. The indexer URL two screens down is logged through indexer.Redact. An operator who mistypes a tokenised gateway gets the secret in their logs. Fix: redact the userinfo and query before quoting it, as indexer.Redact does.
verdicts.evidence: app.go:166 return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid IPFS gateway %q: %w", cfg.RenderConfig.IPFSGateway, err); ipfs.go:56-57 case u.User != nil: must not contain credentials; render.go:98 logger.Warn("ignoring invalid IPFS gateway", "gateway", cfg.IPFSGateway, ...); app.go:245 indexer.Redact(cfg.IndexerURL)
verdicts.verify_by: sed -n 166p gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go and sed -n 98p gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/render.go show the raw value in %q / the slog attr; grep -n indexer.Redact gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go shows the sibling redacting

verdicts.tldr: a %41-encoded CID on a retired gateway is left alone or rewritten depending on an unrelated space later in the path
verdicts.details: splitGatewayPath reads u.EscapedPath(). Go's EscapedPath returns RawPath only when validEncoded accepts it; a space fails validEncoded, so it falls back to escape(Path), where %41 is already decoded to A and validIPFSName accepts the name. The test's untouched case https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41<cid> therefore holds only for paths without such a byte. Nothing unsafe reaches the gateway, since the decoded name stays alphanumeric: the loss is an inconsistent rule, not a bad URL. Fix: decide on u.Path (decoded) or on the raw string consistently, and pin the space case in TestRewriteIPFSURL.
verdicts.evidence: ext_ipfs.go:143 namespace, name, rest = splitGatewayPath(u.EscapedPath()); net/url url.go:688 if u.RawPath != "" && validEncoded(u.RawPath, encodePath) {...return u.RawPath}; url.go:697 return escape(u.Path, encodePath); url.go:718 shouldEscape fails validEncoded for ' '; ext_ipfs_test.go:75 "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41" + testCIDv1 in untouched
verdicts.verify_by: in package markdown: rewriteIPFSURL("https://gw.test", "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41"+testCIDv1+"/a.png") returns false, and the same with "/a b.png" returns true with name A<cid>

verdicts.tldr: base64url CIDs ('u' prefix with - and _) are never rewritten, so their ipfs:// links stay unopenable
verdicts.details: validIPFSName admits only [A-Za-z0-9] for the ipfs namespace, so a base64url multibase CID is rejected and its ipfs:// or retired-gateway link is left as is. The doc comment states the alphanumeric rule as the intent. Whether gateways serve /ipfs/u... (the loss) was not run here, and such CIDs are rare in practice. Fix: allow '-' and '_' for a name starting with 'u', if a gateway check confirms they resolve.
verdicts.evidence: ext_ipfs.go:213-214 'a CID for /ipfs/ is plain alphanumerics'; ext_ipfs.go:225 case 'a' <= c && c <= 'z', 'A' <= c && c <= 'Z', '0' <= c && c <= '9': only; '-' and '.' admitted only for namespace == "ipns". Gateway acceptance of base64url not run.
verdicts.verify_by: rewriteIPFSURL("https://gw.test", "ipfs://uAXASIMPEcz7Ir_0Gz56f9Q_8a80uyFphcABLtwlmnDHelDka/a.png") returns false; confirm a boxo gateway serves /ipfs/u... (go-cid Decode accepts every multibase)
